sequence.decision: If H9 retains a credible positive direction at 200k, continue to H6C-vs-H2. If it reverses materially, stop and reconsider the promoted chain before testing lower links.
sequence.interpretation: At 200k, H9 retains a positive direction (24-16 games; 8-4 paired sweeps) but the 20-pair fresh sample is statistically uncertain. This does not establish H9 as compute-invariant; it also does not show a reversal. Continue to the independent lower lineage link H6C-vs-H2 while keeping H9's 200k status explicitly uncertain.

sequence.decision: Treat this as fresh 200k directional revalidation of H6C over H2. Strong positive evidence retains H6C; a clear reversal requires revisiting the promoted chain; weak positive/neutral evidence remains explicitly uncertain rather than being promoted by inertia.
sequence.interpretation: At 200k, H6C shows a strong positive direction over H2 (27-13 games; 9-2 paired sweeps), but the 20-pair fresh sample remains just above the conventional 0.05 threshold. This supports retaining H6C directionally at high compute without claiming an independent conclusive reconfirmation.

sequence.decision: Treat this as fresh 200k directional revalidation of H2 useful attack over H1. Strong positive evidence retains H2; a clear reversal requires revisiting the promoted chain; weak positive/neutral evidence remains explicitly uncertain.
sequence.interpretation: At 200k, H2 useful attack clearly beats H1 on the fresh 20-pair screen (32-8 games; 14-2 paired sweeps; p=0.004180908203125). This independently reconfirms the direction at high compute. Run the preplanned large fresh-seed confirmation for effect stability and consistency with the other lineage links.

sequence.note: Historical H1 was retained as an experimental incumbent rather than conclusively promoted; rerun this link if final lineage confidence requires it.

guardrails: Use fresh seeds for each link.
Use H12 corrected DAG on both sides.
Do not pool old 10k results with 200k samples as independent evidence.
Do not run lower lineage links until the upper link result is known.
Do not revive rejected H3-H11 hypotheses unless the promoted chain changes.

failed_runs.reason: Batch jobs verified manifest from frozen/engine even though manifest entries were engine/... paths, causing frozen/engine/engine/... lookup failure before any KO games ran.
failed_runs.action: Recovery run reuses the successfully built and A/A-checked frozen artifact; no build or A/A rerun.

confirmation_policy.purpose: The initial 20-pair / 40-game runs are directional high-compute screens, not final re-promotions. Large fresh-seed confirmation follows after the full promoted chain has been screened.
confirmation_policy.trigger: After H9-vs-H6C, H6C-vs-H2 and H2-vs-H1 screens complete, confirm every retained link whose 200k result is positive but still uncertain. Also confirm any link whose result would materially change the final product evaluator.

sample_plan.note: Use fresh holdout seeds and side swapping. Increase toward 200 paired seeds / 400 games if the effect remains borderline and the product decision still depends on it.

confirmation_policy.statistics: Primary inference remains paired sweep sign testing. Split pairs do not contribute to that sign test, so nominal game count can substantially overstate effective paired sample size.
confirmation_policy.execution: Parallelize fresh seed blocks to keep wall-clock time practical, while preserving one frozen engine/config per comparison. Do not pool screening seeds with confirmation as if they were one preregistered sample.

execution_change.reason: H9-vs-H6C and H6C-vs-H2 candidates/configurations are already frozen; their large fresh-seed confirmations are independent of the still-running H2-vs-H1 screen, so run them in parallel to reduce wall-clock time.
execution_change.concurrency: Each confirmation uses 10 batches x 10 paired seeds with max-parallel=5. H2-vs-H1 screen may run concurrently.
execution_change.storage: Per-batch artifacts retain 7 days; summary artifacts retain 30 days.
